title: NDCG@k
signature: def ndcg_at_k(scores: np.ndarray, relevance: np.ndarray, k: int) -> np.ndarray
hints: Rank each query's items by score, descending, with a stable sort so ties keep the lower index first. Keep the first min(k, m).
DCG adds (2^rel - 1) / log2(position + 1) over 1-based positions. With 0-based positions that is log2(j + 2).
IDCG is the DCG of the best possible ranking: sort the query's relevance labels descending over ALL items, not just the retrieved ones. When IDCG is 0, return 0.
